title: Bell's Theorem: The Quantum Venn Diagram Paradox
summary: MinutePhysics, with 3Blue1Brown, explains Bell's theorem using a Venn diagram paradox and polarizing filters. It shows why no local hidden variable theory can reproduce quantum correlations.
why: Repeatedly recommended as the most accessible explanation of Bell's inequality, reducing it to a simple counting problem.

quote.text: did a two part collab that simplifies some of it down to a counting problem that'd be suitable for grade school.
